# VexFlow 4.2.5

Music notation renderer, MIT licence (see LICENSE). Copyright (c) 2010 Mohit Muthanna Cheppudira.
https://www.vexflow.com · https://github.com/0xfe/vexflow

`vexflow-bravura.js` is the unmodified `build/cjs/vexflow-bravura.js` from the npm package
`vexflow@4.2.5` (includes the Bravura music font, SIL Open Font License 1.1). It's loaded only
when a song has a melody (js/notation.js).

To update: `npm pack vexflow@<version>` and copy `build/cjs/vexflow-bravura.js` here.
